title: gentiana amarella var. plebeia
intro: Gentiana amarella var. plebeia, commonly known as American gentian, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. It is prized for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of indigestion. The health benefits of American gentian include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of improving digestion, reducing nausea, and soothing respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of American gentian include gentiopicroside, amarogentin, and gentianine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
